text: Hey Allie! Random thought — would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? Nothing fancy, just the two of you hanging out. Would you invite Jordan? I think he'd really enjoy it, and it'd be nice to have something low-key on the calendar.

Hey Sarah! Yes, I'm up for it — low-key at my place on Saturday at 3:30 works fine. I've put it on my calendar.

One thing I want to get right: you said "just the two of you", so I wasn't sure whether you're coming too or whether you mean me and Jordan. Are you joining us? I'm asking Jordan now either way — let me know and I'll keep you posted.

Hey Jordan! Small thing on the calendar: I'm hosting something low-key at my place this Saturday, 3:30 pm — nothing fancy, just hanging out. Sarah thought you'd really enjoy it, so consider yourself invited. Would you like to come? Let me know and I'll keep you posted on details.
Not me — it's you and Jordan. I've got other things on Saturday, but I hope the two of you enjoy it. Let me know how it goes!
Got it — you and Jordan it is then (you'd have been welcome, of course). I've noted Saturday 3:30 at my place and I'll tell you how it went afterwards. Have a good Saturday yourself!
Small correction so it comes out right on the day: it's you and Jordan — I'm not there. You're the host, he's the guest. Thanks for being up for it!
Understood — I'm the host, Jordan's the guest, you're not there. Noted exactly that way. Thanks for the nudge!
Hey Allie — checking my calendar, one sec.
Yes, count me in — Saturday 3:30 works for me. I've put it in my calendar (3:30-5:30), and I'll shuffle my study session earlier if needed. Send the details whenever you have them!

Great — Saturday 3:30 it is. Details: my place, 3:30 to whenever; nothing fancy, no need to bring anything. I'll have some coffee and snacks out.

Also, small honesty note: Sarah floated this and I invited you, but she has other plans on Saturday, so it'll be just the two of us. If you'd rather have it be a bigger group, say so and I'll invite others.

Looking forward to it — I'll ping you if anything changes.
Works for me — two of us is fine, no need to invite anyone else. I'll be there at 3:30. See you Saturday!
